workstream.title: Prometeo Reincarnable Chat Objects + Parallel Workers

human_intent: Make a long-lived Prometeo working identity exist outside any one ChatGPT conversation so it can be reincarnated into a fresh chat with full mission/design/rules/frontier/worker state, while the main Chat Object can prepublish many jobs and use disposable one-shot worker chats in parallel without human context/result transport.
already_decided: A ChatGPT conversation is a disposable execution shell, not durable memory or identity.
The primary abstraction is a durable Chat Object, not Inbox/Outbox.
Keep project_id, chat_object_id, workstream_id, work_item_id and worker_instance_id distinct.
Fresh `Prometeo` opens Home when unbound; numeric selection resolves to a durable project and preferred Chat Object.
`Prometeo <launch_code>` addresses an exact prepared durable JOB; the human never transports its body or return.
Jobs exist before worker chats are opened.
One-shot workers use independent run/status objects, persist STARTED before execution, RETURN evidence, then DONE/boundary.
Parent/control worker progress is derived from durable run/return state; no central mutable status file.
Parent continues useful work while workers run and recognizes partial/full batch completion from durable evidence.
Normal child feedback is JOB -> Run -> RETURN -> parent integration. Directed messaging is secondary/optional.
Reuse Agent Network v3, EPOCH, compiled packets, Execution Packets, RETURN and Current/Catalog/Lineage instead of rebuilding them.
One parent/steward reconciles overlapping candidates before canonical promotion.
Important goals/design/rules/negative knowledge/dependencies/work/return decisions are distilled into durable Chat Object state while working.
Prior ChatGPT conversations may be searched as optional archaeology/evidence but are never required for correct reincarnation.
Do not rebuild ChatGPT UI/audio capabilities on the critical path.
FACT, HUMAN_ACCEPTED, CANDIDATE, Current and Served remain distinct.
high_value_targets: Fresh conversation selects a Chat Object and reconstructs exact mission/design/rules/frontier/work state without old transcript.
Main Chat Object prepublishes 5-10 jobs and keeps working while disposable workers execute them.
Each worker launches from only a short code, records STARTED, returns durably and marks DONE without human result transport.
Parent truthfully derives 0/N, partial and N/N batch completion from durable state.
Parent consumes/reconciles returns and updates itself durably.
Parent conversation can be erased/replaced while the exact batch and integration frontier survive.
known_failures: Reducing cross-chat continuity to an Inbox/message-bus problem.
Depending on conversation memory/transcript as the only project map.
Launching workers before their durable JOB/context/return contract exists.
Making the human copy worker prompts/context/results.
Making all workers mutate one central status file.
Inferring worker completion from silence or self-report without durable return evidence.
Blocking the parent merely because workers are still running.
Duplicating shared capabilities before resolving owners.
Reading all repository/network/history on every turn.
Allowing worker candidates/newest commits to self-promote to Current/Human Accepted/Served.
Rebuilding custom ChatGPT UI/audio as core infrastructure.

workers.frontier: Parent/orchestrator: keep the durable Chat Object current, observe/integrate B-CHATOBJ-01 worker runs/returns, and implement shared bootstrap/runtime/compiler changes that workers identify. Child workers own only their own work-item run/return subtrees.
workers.last_useful_delta: Pivoted from mailbox-first coordination to reincarnable Chat Object + prepared JOB/independent Run/RETURN architecture; created durable Chat Object, blueprint, Work Board, Shared Graph, six dispatchable jobs, run/return contracts and launch-code bootstrap semantics.

last_return.useful_delta: Re-read the user's recent corrections and restored the larger Prometeo intent: workers are no longer modeled as finite one-shot queue consumers. Published a binding Universal Cognitive Worker model with guide-grade cognition/scoped authority, a stale/recovery protocol, a staged multi-surface swarm plan, and a 60-opportunity high-parallelism queue with 52 explicitly READY lanes. Upgraded /wc to v3.0 on main and gh-pages so identical fresh chats can execute, discover, plan locally, critique, verify, integrate locally, compile context, recover stalls, chain sequential work and re-enter allocation. Bound four surfaces (Plan de acción/Universal Control, Prometeo móvil, Facultad Digital/Study Library, Alumnos/página docente) to parallel micro-swarm discovery and dependency-gated local integration. Preserved the existing GEN2 recursive-Planner track in parallel. Production /w remains evidence-gated.
updated_artifacts: wc main + gh-pages -> v3.0 universal cognitive worker canary

prepared_frontier.broad_wave_target: approximately 50 identical fresh chats as a measured canary

last_return.critical_truth: The system is now prepared to USE a ~50-chat identical-worker wave without manually numbering 50 jobs, because 52 distinct/complementary READY lanes exist and /wc v3.0 can re-enter allocation and attempt discovery/recovery. This is still a canary: usefulness/safety, dynamic dependency activation, stale takeover and local integration become operational only when durable runtime receipts prove them. Chat turns still do not wake themselves; fully unattended timed stale scanning requires the external metabolism runtime.
next_frontier: Consume returns incrementally; do not wait for the entire wave.
As surface dependency returns accumulate, let universal workers derive and claim local integration successors automatically.
Preserve and advance GEN2 recursive-Planner implementation in the same allocator.
Run the independent ~50-worker stress verifier and fresh strategic critic when their dependencies are satisfied.
Promote toward production /w only from evidence-backed readiness, never from this preparation alone.
last_return.recovery: Any fresh guide uses /g -> Continuity Head -> FOCUS -> exact five active queues/claims/runs/returns/recovery/proposals. Any fresh worker uses the identical /wc v3.0 bootstrap. No old chat or human result transport is required.

relevant_global_deltas.summary: Prometeo now has one stable agent entrypoint, NOW router, scoped task packs, delta propagation and compact returns. Fresh chats should route before repository archaeology.
relevant_global_deltas.action: Start from `.well-known/prometeo.json`; do not reconstruct every historical subsystem before knowing the task.

relevant_global_deltas.summary: Prometeo Agent Runtime v2 compiles one current Work Packet per active workstream, includes only relevant cross-chat/branch deltas, defines FAST/DEEP/EXHAUSTIVE/CONTINUE profiles, and adds the visible Prometeo Seal.
relevant_global_deltas.action: Prefer the compiled packet from `/agent-runtime/manifest.json` over manually reconstructing NOW/PACK/RETURN/DELTA. `Prometeo` means resync+recover+continue; `.` means continue the active frontier. Print `🟣 P✓` only after entry+packet were actually loaded.

relevant_global_deltas.summary: Agent Network v3 adds a tiny EPOCH freshness check, independent per-chat worker status, auto-discovered workstreams, derived read-only NETWORK/CONVERGENCE views and filtered cross-chat dependency/impact events in Work Packet v3.
relevant_global_deltas.action: After one-time bootstrap, read EPOCH before material work. Same EPOCH means continue immediately; new EPOCH means reload only the active compiled Work Packet. Do not read all other chats or edit a shared central status file.

relevant_global_deltas.summary: Cross-chat handoff must not make the human copy a large prompt. Before asking the human to switch chats, the source worker publishes material state to its LAST_RETURN and any truly cross-workstream discovery to DELTA_FEED (or a scoped worker status). The destination chat receives only `Prometeo`, detects the new EPOCH and consumes the compiled relevant packet/deltas.
relevant_global_deltas.action: Treat the repository/runtime as the message bus. Do not ask the human to relay a recoverable prompt between Prometeo chats. If a destination chat needs an explicit instruction payload, persist it in the relevant workstream/return first, then tell the human only which chat to open and to send `Prometeo`.

relevant_global_deltas.summary: R02 recovered PROMETEO LAB R1-B against live Current/Lineage. Later Prometeo already owns the architecture through Part 2 tested-candidate modules (Context Foundry v2, persistence, durable ledger, workflow/reincarnation and candidate Classes/Student World engines) plus later P3 release/rollback evidence. Recovery therefore preserves routing and invariants instead of creating a second architecture or promoting internal candidates.
relevant_global_deltas.action: Route future changes to the existing scoped owner. Preserve Candidate/Current/Human Accepted/Served separation, Context Foundry privacy/currentness fail-closed rules, staged-CAS versus durable-ledger separation and distinct release/canary/acceptance/serve/rollback/export gates. Do not resurrect historical R1-B package/file-count/checkpoint claims unless exact durable bytes are recovered.

refresh_contract.same_epoch: Continue without reading NETWORK/DELTA; do not recompile context.
refresh_contract.new_epoch: Reload only this compiled packet; it already contains filtered relevant changes.

FAST.use_when: The requested change is explicit, local, reversible and does not require material architectural decisions.
forbidden_overhead: release receipts for ordinary LAB iteration

DEEP.use_when: The task is materially ambiguous, multi-file, design-heavy or benefits from deciding the space before editing.
sequence: CONTEXT FIRST: write the material understanding that can change execution
COMPLETE MAP: name all meaningful parts before diving into part one
DEVELOP: resolve important decisions under those headings
EXECUTE: implement as much of the map as tool/context boundaries allow
CRITIQUE: inspect the actual result for contradictions and lost value
REPAIR: fix worker-soluble failures in the same work cycle
DEEP.rule: Context/map/specification are decision compression, not deliverables to endlessly regenerate.

EXHAUSTIVE.use_when: The human explicitly requests exhaustive coverage/a numbered map, or the work is structural enough that omission risk dominates.
sequence: print the complete requested title map once
develop it at the requested depth
execute continuously from the frozen frontier
rules: A requested count such as 100 is a coverage matrix, not permission for filler.
After PLAN:FROZEN, later turns must not regenerate the same plan.
N/A or DEFER with a reason is better than fake work.
A response-length boundary is not a project boundary; persist the frontier and continue.

CONTINUE.use_when: The conversation already has a materially sufficient context/map/specification or the human sends dot to continue.

automatic_selection.explicit_exhaustive_or_existing_frozen_l: EXHAUSTIVE or CONTINUE when already frozen

Create independent worker/run identity when write transport is available.
Execute prepared JOB using only required context.
Persist durable RETURN/evidence, then DONE or real terminal boundary.
Never ask the human to paste the JOB body or carry the return to parent.
If bound work is active, compare tiny EPOCH first.
If unchanged, continue current frontier without regenerating settled design or rereading unrelated Network/history.
If changed, reload only relevant compiled/durable state and filtered convergence/dependency changes.

execution.frontier: Make delegated launch/run/batch state executable on top of Agent Network + runtime compiler, then run and integrate the prepared six-job batch B-CHATOBJ-01 and prove full fresh-parent reincarnation.

seal.rule: HOME seal requires stable entry + Home selector. Chat Object seal requires durable Chat Object/relevant packet load. Work-item seal requires exact JOB load/validation.

instructions: MANDATORY: load and obey the Global Agent Constitution before material writes.
Treat normal change requests as preserve-first deltas against authoritative Current; never clean-slate rewrite by convenience.
Before important writes/publication re-check EPOCH, reload this packet if changed, re-fetch target bytes and block only on overlapping active writers.
Use this packet as compiled working context; do not repeat repository archaeology.
Before material work in an already-bootstrapped chat, compare the tiny public EPOCH id with the last seen id. If unchanged, continue immediately.
If EPOCH changed, reload only this packet; consume only relevant cross-chat events included here.
Recover the last materially unsatisfied human intent from the conversation before asking the human to repeat anything.
If branch/upstream activity is listed, reconcile only those commits before material work.
Existing frozen plans must be continued, not regenerated.
Prefer implementation + critique + repair in one cycle; checks are evidence, not progress.
On completion/boundary release any active worker claim and return the human through the Universal Host/Page Change Feed when page-scoped.
